strings: m_c's eyes are much more sensitive to light that usual.
As soon as m_c steps out of the den, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} yowls and retreats back to the shadows.
m_c's sensitive eyes have been acting up again.
r_c0 recommends m_c to stay in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} den, at least until sundown, to allow this episode of light sensitivity to pass.
